item.title: [IGNITE-2767] Cont. query remote filter requires to be in client nodes class path
item.description:

item.summary: Cont. query remote filter requires to be in client nodes class path

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment:
Denis,

As far as I know we only print out the error without stopping the join process. Probably this can be improved form usability standpoint, but it doesn't break anything, right?

Val,

Thanks for pointing out to this. Correct, according to the sources the join process won't be terminated. However, right, we have to improve the usability here writing at least more specific messages.

I could reproduce the issue in source.
I continue to work tomorrow.

I made some changes (https://github.com/apache/ignite/pull/805).
dmagda, can you please review?

Vlad, thanks.

Slightly modified you fix from usability standpoint. The following warning will be printed instead "Failed to unmarshal continuous query remote filter on client node. Can be ignored."

Merged the changes.
